concept-card.purpose: A named semantic concept with a compact summary.

workspace-container.purpose: A model or bounded scope that owns other semantic content.

participant-card.purpose: A human, organization, system, or stakeholder participating in the domain.

capability-container.purpose: A business responsibility boundary; related concepts remain linked, not nested.

class-card.purpose: A domain concept whose identity, lifecycle, and attributes matter.

value-object-card.purpose: An immutable descriptive value without independent identity.

command-lozenge.purpose: An intent that changes business state.

query-trapezoid.purpose: An information request that does not change business state.

event-hexagon.purpose: A business fact that has already occurred.

condition-diamond.purpose: A predicate used to guard, branch, or validate behavior.

process-step.purpose: An executable or human step inside a business process.

relationship-edge.purpose: A semantic relationship represented by a connector rather than a node.

badge.purpose: A compact nested detail or classification.

universalSyntax.nodeRule: Every visible canvas element has one semantic type, a stable label, a type token, and a small set of high-signal line fields.
universalSyntax.edgeRule: Use connectors for intentional cross-object semantics; edit attributes and high-cardinality details in the inspector.
universalSyntax.containerRule: Open only Ecore containment boundaries. Cross-boundary membership and references remain links or inspector values.
universalSyntax.zoomRule: At low zoom show type, name, status, and counts; reveal fields and edge labels progressively as the user zooms in.
universalSyntax.complexityRule: A view is a question-specific working surface, not a projection of every EClass in the metamodel.

kernelSyntax.traceRule: TraceModel and TraceLink are an optional purple overlay; trace links are never confused with domain relationships.
kernelSyntax.readinessRule: Production-readiness findings and checks are inspector/dashboard details, not ordinary domain nodes.
kernelSyntax.metadataRule: Expressions, multiplicities, annotations, and other kernel support objects are edited through their owning element and are not palette concepts.

complexityManagement.behavior: Use named synchronized views scoped by semantic purpose instead of a single all-elements canvas.
Major containers support collapsed, summary, and expanded modes with counts and exposed ports.
Far zoom shows containers and counts; mid zoom shows cards and ports; near zoom shows compartments and edge labels.
Containment, structural, behavioral, policy, trace, readiness, and generated edges are independently filterable.
Selecting an element can focus a depth-1 or depth-2 neighborhood and fade unrelated nodes.
Search indexes names, ids, tags, source refs, routes, event names, logical ids, and AWS types where present.
EVL/readiness findings appear as markers and sortable issue lists that highlight affected elements.
Trace links remain a separate layer with confidence filters.
Views persist filters, layout, camera positions, and edge-layer choices.
